payload.subject: ✅ 前端文件已移入 generatorProductCodes 子目录
payload.content:
## 完成情况

1. 创建 `generatorProductCodes/` 子目录
2. 移动 `index.html` → `generatorProductCodes/index.html`
3. 移动 `codeList.html` → `generatorProductCodes/codeList.html`
4. 更新 codeListUrl 路径: `.../commonProductionStages/codeList.html` → `.../commonProductionStages/generatorProductCodes/codeList.html`

目录结构：
```
commonProductionStages/
├── ProductComponents/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── create_edit.html
│   └── autoAssembly.html
└── generatorProductCodes/
    ├── index.html
    └── codeList.html
```
